<observations>
Date: Mar 20, 2026
* 🔴 (07:12) User stated they will enforce strict null checks in the Ledgerly TypeScript config.
* 🔴 (09:40) User stated the SOC 2 audit fieldwork starts on May 19, 2026.
* 🔴 (10:30) User decided to switch the database from SQLite to PostgreSQL for production.
* 🟡 (12:00) User asked about caching `node_modules` in CI, which the Agent implemented.
* 🟡 (14:05) ✅ Agent configured Jest coverage threshold to enforce 85% coverage.
* 🟡 (15:10) Agent linted source files with ESLint, fixing 7 warnings.
* 🟡 (18:00) Agent generated API documentation for the `/invoices` endpoint.
* 🔴 (20:30) User asked for a summary of pending pull requests and their reviewers.

Date: Mar 23, 2026
* 🔴 (07:05) User announced they will adopt semantic commit messages for all future commits.
* 🟡 (08:45) Agent ran integration tests for the payment webhook (5 passed, 1 flaky).
* 🟡 (09:20) Agent merged PR #42 (add discount code validation) after review from @sara.
* 🟡 (10:30) Agent updated Dockerfile to use `node:18-alpine` base image.
* 🟡 (11:15) Agent added a GitHub Actions step to upload test artifacts to S3.
* 🟡 (11:50) User asked if the new discount feature could be toggled via feature flag, which the Agent implemented using LaunchDarkly.
* 🟡 (13:00) ✅ Agent updated README with setup instructions for LaunchDarkly.
* 🔴 (13:00) User stated the public API rate limit is 300 requests per minute.
* 🟡 (13:45) Agent refactored invoice PDF generation to use the `pdf-lib` library.
* 🟢 (14:30) User will attend a virtual meetup on TypeScript best practices at 16:00.
* 🟡 (15:15) Agent scheduled a meeting with the UX designer to discuss invoice layout redesign.

Date: Mar 26, 2026
* 🔴 (07:12) User declared they will start using TypeScript strict mode across the repo.
* 🟡 (09:05) Agent ran unit tests for the tax calculation module (all 32 passed).
* 🟡 (09:50) Agent opened PR #58 to add locale-aware date formatting.
* 🟡 (11:10) Agent updated CI workflow to cache `node_modules` for faster builds.
* ✅ (12:00) Agent merged PR #58 (locale-aware date formatting) after approval from @mike.
* 🟡 (12:45) Agent added `EMAIL_SMTP_URL` to `.env.example`.
* 🟡 (14:15) Agent implemented email notification for overdue invoices using `nodemailer`.
* 🟡 (15:00) Agent refactored logging to use `pino` library with JSON output.
* 🔴 (16:40) User asked whether the recurring invoice feature could be paused per client, which the Agent implemented using a ConfigCat feature toggle.
* 🟡 (19:45) Agent scheduled a demo session with the sales team to showcase recurring invoices.

Date: Mar 29, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) User decided to adopt dark mode UI across the Ledgerly dashboard.
* 🟡 (08:30) Agent added CSS variables for light and dark themes and implemented a React toggle component.
* 🔴 (10:20) User stated the public API rate limit was raised to 500 requests per minute.
* 🟡 (12:05) Agent merged the `feature/dark-mode` branch after code review from @sara.
* 🟡 (12:45) Agent updated the CI pipeline to run visual regression tests with Percy.
* ✅ (13:30) Agent deployed the dark mode feature to the staging environment for QA.
* 🔴 (14:15) User asked if bulk invoice upload could support Excel (.xlsx) files, which the Agent implemented via a new endpoint using SheetJS.
* 🟡 (16:20) Agent ran integration tests for bulk upload (12 passed, 2 skipped).

Date: Apr 2, 2026
* 🔴 (07:10) User decided to add recurring invoice templates to Ledgerly.
* 🟡 (07:55) Agent created a `recurring_invoices` database table and implemented an API endpoint to manage templates.
* 🟡 (10:55) Agent wrote and passed 15 unit tests for the recurring endpoint.
* 🔴 (11:40) User asked whether PDF invoices could include a company logo watermark, which the Agent implemented using `pdfmake`.
* ✅ (13:15) Agent deployed the PDF watermark feature to the staging environment for QA review.
* 🟢 (14:00) Teammate Luis reported staging server CPU spikes after new jobs ran.
* 🟡 (15:05) Agent added a background job using BullMQ to process PDF generation asynchronously.
* 🟡 (16:20) Agent updated CI to include a load-test step simulating 200 concurrent PDF requests.
* ✅ (17:45) Agent merged the `feature/recurring-invoices` branch after approval from @kim.

Date: Apr 6, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) User decided to integrate Stripe for handling subscription payments in Ledgerly.
* 🟡 (07:50) Agent created a `stripeService.ts` module and set up a webhook endpoint.
* 🟡 (10:50) Agent wrote and passed 12 integration tests for the Stripe webhook.
* 🔴 (11:35) User asked whether payment receipt emails could include a QR code linking to the invoice, which the Agent implemented using the `qrcode` library.
* ✅ (13:00) Agent deployed the Stripe integration and QR code email feature to the development environment for internal review.
* 🟢 (14:15) Teammate Maya reported the local dev database grew to 3.2 GB after loading sample data.
* 🟡 (15:40) Agent added a nightly cron database cleanup script to prune orphaned payment records.
* 🟡 (16:30) Assistant recommended Redis Streams for the background job queue, and the user agreed to try it.
* 🟡 (16:55) Agent updated CI pipeline to include a security scan using Snyk for new dependencies.
* ✅ (18:20) Agent merged the `feature/stripe-integration` branch after approval from @alex.
</observations>
<current-task>
* 🔴 User asked for a summary of pending pull requests and their reviewers (from Mar 20, 2026).
* 🟡 Agent needs to implement Redis Streams for the background job queue (agreed on Apr 6, 2026).
* 🟡 Agent needs to discuss invoice layout redesign with the UX designer (scheduled on Mar 23, 2026).
</current-task>

I can provide a summary of pending pull requests and their reviewers. Would you like me to fetch that information now?
</suggested-response>
